comments.body:
Quest name: Constellations of The Goat and Fish (Chrono Quest, Mythical Era)
Quest location: London Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r8 Recognition, r10 Astronomy, Ara (Arabic)
Pre-requisite discovery: Sagittarius discovery (from quest "The Archer That Aims for the Scorpion"), Relief of Ea (From quest "Mesopotamia's Magic God")

Note: This quest for Capricorn discovery is a part of the zodiac series of astronomy quests.
